column2: Adverbial clauses of concession with although / though · 情景运用(第4轮)
although/though introduces a concession: cannot be used together with but.本课为情景运用练习,核心:although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。

although = though, placed at the start|the main clause cannot use but, but can use yet/still|even though has a stronger tone|though can appear at the end of a sentence|despite/in spite of + noun also express concession
Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
column3: 虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。

column1: _____ it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
column4: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 Although。句意:虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。

column2: Though he is young, he knows a lot.
column3: 虽然他年纪小,但懂得很多。

column2: Even he is young, he knows a lot.|Though he is young, he knows a lot.|Despite he is young, he knows a lot.|Though but he is young, he knows a lot.
column4: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Though he is young, he knows a lot.

column2: Although she was tired, she kept working.
column3: 虽然她很累,仍继续工作。

column1: 「虽然她很累,仍继续工作。」的正确英文是?
column2: Although she was tired, she but kept working.|Although she was tired, she kept working.|Although she was tired, she was keeping working.|Although she was tired, she keeps working.
column4: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although she was tired, she kept working.

column2: Even though the task was hard, we finished it.
column3: 尽管任务很难,我们还是完成了。

column1: _____ the task was hard, we finished it.
column4: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 Even though。句意:尽管任务很难,我们还是完成了。

column2: He passed the exam though he was ill.
column3: 虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。

column2: He passed the exam however he was ill.|He passed the exam but he was ill.|He passed the exam though he was ill.|He passed the exam despite he was ill.
column4: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:He passed the exam though he was ill.

column2: Although the shop is small, it has everything.
column3: 这家店虽然小,但什么都有。

column1: 「这家店虽然小,但什么都有。」的正确英文是?
column2: Despite the shop is small, it has everything.|Although the shop is small, it has everything.|However the shop is small, it has everything.|Although but the shop is small, it has everything.
column4: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although the shop is small, it has everything.
